sections.text:

sections.title: Get all DBs replica sources alert states
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/replica_sources/alerts

Get all alert states for all replica sources of all BDBs.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_all_bdbs_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_all_bdbs_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/replica_sources/alerts 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of alert UIDs and the alerts states for each BDB.

See [REST API alerts overview](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) for a description of the alert state object.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Get DB replica source alert states
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/replica_sources/alerts/{int: uid}

Get all alert states for all replica sources of a specific bdb.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/replica_sources/alerts/1 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the database |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of [alert objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) and their states.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified bdb does not exist |

sections.title: Get replica source alert state
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/replica_sources/alerts/{int: uid}/{int: replica_src_id}/{alert}

Get a replica source alert state of a specific bdb.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/replica_sources/alerts/1/2/replica_src_syncer_connection_error 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the database |
| replica_src_id | integer | The ID of the replica source in this BDB |
| alert | string | The alert name |

Returns an [alert state object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert).
